Change is brewing at “Morning Joe.”

Willie Geist will leave MS NOW’s flagship morning show at the end of the year to take on an expanded role at NBC’s “Today” franchise, whose “Sunday Today” broadcast he has hosted since 2016.

Geist’s departure marks the end of a nearly two-decade run alongside husband-and-wife co-hosts Joe Scarborough and Mika Brzezinski, with whom he has appeared on the program since its 2007 launch.

The trio announced the news on Monday’s broadcast.

Watch here:

Scarborough acknowledged it was “not easy news to give,” even though they were expecting it.

“We knew this was coming, but it makes it no less difficult,” said Geist, who expressed gratitude for being the only employee allowed to continue working for both NBC and MS NOW following their corporate split last year.

The arrangement “was never intended to last forever,” he said.

“And so it is with a very heavy heart, heavy with memories and experiences and friends and family, like the two people on the screen with me right now, that I announce my run on ‘Morning Joe’ will end next month,” he continued. “A run that’s lasted nearly 20 years beside the two of you have been the joy of a lifetime, the job of a lifetime. This is just the way it is sometimes in business.”

Geist explained the timing of his exit was influenced by the midterm elections.

“I knew working for two companies wasn’t going to last forever, and there was an informal understanding that it would go through the midterms, that those elections were so important,” he said. “And this show being front and center during those elections, and guiding our audience through them, was an important place to get to.”

“And now here we are. So as of Dec. 31, it’s a surreal thing to say. It’s a sad thing to say out loud, but I will not be on ‘Morning Joe,’” he said. “There’ll be time for a full goodbye in the weeks ahead. But for now, I just say thank you to my beloved friends Joe and Mika and to the audience that we consider — truly consider — family.”

Scarborough said he and Brzezinski were “so grateful to have been us three, to be part of this family with you and the others that have come through over the past 20 years.”

Brzezinski, meanwhile, said she was “proud” and “happy” for Geist but also sad to see him go.
